item.name: Analyze a raw ingredient list (creates a scan + product if needed)

request.description:
Kicks off the full AI analysis pipeline: matches ingredients against
the knowledge base, computes the safety score, generates the AI
summary/allergy warning, and persists a `scan`. This is an
asynchronous, job-backed endpoint — poll `GET /scans/{scanId}` or
subscribe via Supabase Realtime for completion.
